correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Ind_2(K_{1,b})=Delta(B) union a*discrete(B); its H1 lattice is the augmentation kernel and homotopy wedge^{b-1}S1. Deleting center gives join of star factors with degree 2k-1. The central link is Delta(B) with k cones; for >=2 positive branches it is contractible, for one positive branch it has two components, for none k discrete points. Cofiber X=D union c*L gives all boundary cases, including k=0/1. Link contractibility induces integral equivariant H; join permutations of degree-one classes carry sign (-1)^((1+1)(1+1))=+1. A branch-cycle tensor trace is composite leaf fixed points minus one. Independently enumerated 119 root-size patterns (k<=4, b_i<=2, up to 12 vertices) using direct induced-component predicate and exact F2 chain ranks; all expected ranks agree. General proof, not finite tests, establishes integral assertion.
residual_risks: Finite mod-two tests do not exclude torsion or prove all branch sizes; integral join/cofiber proof supplies those facts.
Equivariant statement is only about induced integral H-module, not equivariant homotopy.
